cohort: 180 women at term (37-41+6 weeks) with singleton pregnancy, excluding those with multiple pregnancy, caesarean delivery, antepartum hemorrhage, and chorioamnionitis.
finding: Risk factors for genital tract trauma following vaginal delivery included multiparity, referral status, spontaneous birth, and birth weight >4 kg.
mod_finding: Assisted mode of delivery was associated with genital tract trauma.
